results: 1. nerve conduction studies / EMG: rhythmic bursts in both hands, synchronised with the visible jerks
2. EEG: no abnormality, and no EEG-EMG correlation on video-EEG - the myoclonus is subcortical
3. somatosensory evoked potentials: NO giant SSEP - argues against a cortical origin
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-COVID-19 myoclonus (subcortical, brainstem reticular-type myoclonus secondary to recent SARS-CoV-2 infection)

1. Autoimmune encephalitis (e.g., anti-GAD, post-infectious autoimmune encephalitis unrelated to COVID)
2. Hashimoto's encephalopathy (steroid-responsive encephalopathy with myoclonus)
3. Drug- or metabolic/toxin-induced myoclonus (unrelated to recent infection)
dx: Post-COVID-19 myoclonus (subcortical, brainstem reticular-type myoclonus secondary to recent SARS-CoV-2 infection)
